title: Math Panda: a mental math quiz for iOS with a friendly AI character
description: I released Math Panda, an iOS mental math quiz with visual hints and an AI-powered panda character, made for kids and useful for adults.
body:
I have just released my personal iOS app, Math Panda. It is a mental math quiz with visual hints and a friendly AI-powered character, a cute panda.

It is made for kids, but adults will find it useful too. The goal is the same for everyone: practice mental math in a fun way.

## What is inside

Math Panda has three parts that work together.

- Quizzes with visual hints, so a child can see the numbers instead of only reading them.
- Tasks and analytics, so you can follow how practice is going.
- A chat with the panda, which answers any question.

AI handles the tasks, the quizzes, the analytics and the chat. The chat is built to be fully safe and kid-friendly.

## Why a character

Math drills are dry. A friendly character gives a child someone to practice with. The panda explains, asks, and answers questions in a way a kid can follow.

Adults get the same practice. Quick mental arithmetic is a skill that fades if you do not use it, and a short quiz is an easy way to keep it.

## Support an indie app

I am an indie developer, so every App Store review and every piece of feedback means a lot to me. If you try the app, tell me what works and what does not.

You can search for Math Panda on the App Store, or open it here: [Math Panda on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746938495).
